question: What form and size of Gaṇeśa must be prepared for the rite?
premises: An image or form is to be prepared.
It is of the great-souled Gaṇeśa.
Its measure is the size of a thumb.
inference: A thumb-sized form of the great-souled Gaṇeśa must be prepared.
uncertainties: The material of the form is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should make a thumb-sized image of the great-souled Gaṇeśa.
